Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Today at a glance across all accounts.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used across the app.
Settings.currencyDescription: The USD/ARS rate auto-updates daily from Saldo — what it actually costs you to buy USD. Used to convert Mercado Libre revenue and peso-denominated costs (like local shipping on a shipment) into USD. The manual value below is only a fallback if Saldo is unreachable.

Products.title: Products
Products.description: Your product catalog and live stock.
Products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or brand…
Products.name: Name

ProductForm.addToCatalog: Add a product to the catalog.
ProductForm.name: Name
ProductForm.weightHint: Used to split shipment freight. Leave blank to split by value instead.

AdjustStock.adjustmentHint: Positive adds units, negative removes them.

AddStock.description: Adds units with their cost without registering a purchase — stock you already have or that is on its way.
AddStock.statusHint: Warehouse, Available or In Full can be sold right away; any other status counts as in transit. The date sets FIFO order (defaults to today).

MoveFull.toFullHint: Up to {max} units at the depot. For stock already in Full, without creating a Full shipment.
MoveFull.toDepotHint: Up to {max} units placed in Full by hand. Units from a Full shipment are managed from the shipment.

Purchases.title: Purchases
Purchases.description: One row per purchase. A purchase that arrives in parts is split into two rows, each with its own arrival date.
Purchases.noPurchasesYet: No purchases yet. Import an Amazon order to get started.

PurchaseOrder.taxShippingSplitNote: The order’s {tax} tax and {shipping} shipping are split across the products by value, so each one carries its own share.
PurchaseOrder.noTaxShippingNote: No tax or shipping was recorded for this order, so each product’s total is just the price paid.
PurchaseOrder.landedFreightNote: Landed adds the USA → Argentina courier bill from the shipment.
PurchaseOrder.freightPendingNote: The USA → Argentina freight is added later, when the shipment is costed.

PurchaseImport.title: Import purchases
PurchaseImport.description: Fill this in from an Amazon order screenshot, or enter the items by hand — tax + shipping are split across items into each per-unit landed cost.
PurchaseImport.noItemsFound: No items were found in that order
PurchaseImport.matchedExisting: {count, plural, one {# matched to existing products} other {# matched to existing products}}
PurchaseImport.taxShippingHint: The tax and shipping above are Amazon’s. Import freight is added later, when the box lands and you enter the courier bill on the shipment.
PurchaseImport.productNamePlaceholder: e.g. DJI Mic Mini (1 TX + 1 RX)

PurchaseForm.createsInventoryBatch: Creates an inventory batch for the product.
PurchaseForm.arrivedAtHint: Optional. When it reached the courier in the USA.

OrderStatusSelect.linesUpdated: {count, plural, one {# line updated} other {# lines updated}}

PasteOrderImport.step1: Copy the prompt and open Claude.

warning.noItems: No items were found on that screenshot

warning.grandTotalMismatch: Items + tax + shipping is {computed} but the grand total reads {grandTotal}

ScreenshotDropzone.dropHint: Paste, drop, or click to add an Amazon order screenshot
ScreenshotDropzone.dropDescription: Order number, date, items, quantities, tax and shipping are filled in below for you to review. Add several screenshots at once for a long order.

Shipments.title: Shipments
Shipments.description: Each box travelling to Argentina. Enter the courier bill when one lands and it is split across everything inside.
Shipments.noShipmentsYet: No shipments yet. Create one, then add the purchases travelling in it.

ShipmentDetail.costedDescription: Costed — freight is folded into every unit’s landed cost.
ShipmentDetail.openDescription: Add the purchases travelling in this box, then enter the courier bill when it lands.

ShipmentForm.shipmentExplainer: A shipment is one physical box travelling to Argentina. Its freight bill gets split across whatever is inside once it lands.
ShipmentForm.estimatedFreightHint: Optional. Lets you price listings while the box is still in transit — the actual bill replaces it on arrival.
ShipmentForm.notesPlaceholder: Tracking number, consolidator, anything worth remembering.

ShipmentCosting.landedCostsUpdated: {count, plural, one {Landed costs updated across # product} other {Landed costs updated across # products}} — stock is now in the warehouse
ShipmentCosting.unitsAlreadySold: {count, plural, one {# unit was} other {# units were}} already sold from this shipment. Those sales keep the profit they were booked with.
ShipmentCosting.estimateSpread: Estimate of {value} spread across the box
ShipmentCosting.shipmentReopened: Shipment reopened — costs stay as they are until you cost it again
ShipmentCosting.convertedAtSaldoRate: Converted at the Saldo buy rate, {rate}/USD.
ShipmentCosting.fallbackMissingWeight: {count, plural, one {# product is} other {# products are}} missing a weight — splitting by {basis} instead
ShipmentCosting.fallbackNoCost: No line has a cost yet — splitting evenly per unit instead
ShipmentCosting.addWeightSuffix: to split this bill by weight instead.
ShipmentCosting.residualNote: {value} of the bill {direction} because the split doesn’t divide evenly into whole cents per unit.

AssignBatches.unassignedExplainer: Purchases not in any shipment yet, grouped by the day they reached the courier. Each goes in whole, or enter how many units go and the rest stays as another purchase.
AssignBatches.nothingUnassigned: Nothing unassigned — every purchase is already in a shipment.

FullShipments.title: Full Shipments
FullShipments.description: Boxes of received stock sent to Mercado Libre’s Full warehouse, built per product. Status is confirmed automatically once ML reports them received.
FullShipments.noneYet: No Full shipments yet. Create one with the inbound ID Mercado Libre gave you in the seller panel.

FullShipmentForm.explainer: The Full inbound is created in Mercado Libre’s seller panel, which gives you an inbound ID — paste it here and pick how many units of each received product go in the box.
FullShipmentForm.mlInboundIdHint: The ID Mercado Libre assigned when the inbound request was created in the seller panel.
FullShipmentForm.notesPlaceholder: Carrier, tracking number, anything worth remembering.
FullShipmentForm.receivedExplainer: Stock received at your depot that hasn’t gone to Full. Send part of each product or all of it.

FullShipmentDetail.sentDescription: On its way — only confirmed once Mercado Libre reports it arrived at the Full warehouse.
FullShipmentDetail.receivedDescription: Received by Mercado Libre — already in the Full warehouse.
FullShipmentDetail.noProductsIncluded: No products in this box yet.

Sales.title: Sales
Sales.description: Orders imported automatically from Mercado Libre.
Sales.returnsExplainer: Revenue is already reversed. Stock comes back only once you confirm the goods arrived.

ReceiveReturn.awaitingReceipt: {productName} — {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} awaiting receipt.
ReceiveReturn.restockingExplainer: Restocking returns the units to their original batch at the cost they sold at. Writing off keeps them out of stock and books the cost as a loss.

ReverseSale.explainer: Cancel is for an order that never shipped — stock goes back immediately. Open return reverses the money now and waits for you to confirm the goods arrived.

Accounts.title: Mercado Libre Accounts
Accounts.description: Connect and manage your seller accounts.
Accounts.unmappedListings: {count, plural, one {# unmapped listing} other {# unmapped listings}}

AccountListings.description: Map Mercado Libre listings to internal products so sales decrement the right stock.
AccountListings.noListingsImported: No listings imported. Use "Sync listings" on the account.

Arrival.title: Register arrival at courier
Arrival.hint: When it reached the courier in the USA. If not all units arrived, enter how many: the purchase is split in two.
Arrival.splitHint: The purchase is split: {arrived} arrive on this date and {rest} stay pending as another purchase.
Arrival.editHint: Only the date changes. To register another arrival, use the purchase still pending.

ReceivedStockPicker.selected: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}
ReceivedStockPicker.nothingReceived: No received stock available to send to Full.

AddProductsToFull.explainer: Received stock that hasn’t gone to Full. Pick how many units of each product to add.

BulkOrderImport.title: Bulk import purchases
BulkOrderImport.description: Paste a JSON array of supplier orders and import them all at once. Each order's tax + shipping is split across its items, exactly like the single import.
BulkOrderImport.formatHint: An array of orders, each with its items:
BulkOrderImport.fieldsHint: Required: items[].name, items[].unitPrice (USD per unit, before tax). Optional: orderNumber, supplier (default Amazon), purchasedAt / arrivedAt / estimatedArrivalAt (YYYY-MM-DD), discount, tax, shipping, items[].quantity (default 1), items[].sku (maps onto that product, or becomes the new product's SKU). Up to 100 orders.
BulkOrderImport.shipmentHint: Applies to every order below. Import freight is added later, when the box arrives.
BulkOrderImport.summary: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} · {units} units · {newProducts, plural, =0 {no new products} one {# new product} other {# new products}} ·
BulkOrderImport.imported: {count, plural, one {# order imported} other {# orders imported}}
